control_objective: All in-scope AI systems are registered and the record is current
test_method: Sample discovery sources for unregistered systems and compare to inventory

control_objective: Every registered system has an assigned tier with written rationale
test_method: Sample intake records for presence and adequacy of rationale

control_objective: Every system has a named owner with authority to suspend it
No in-scope system reaches production before its review completes
test_method: Compare production deployment records to approval records

control_objective: Conditions are specific owned and closed by their due date
Systems are reassessed on trigger and on cycle
Retired systems are marked retired with data disposition documented
test_method: Sample retired systems for disposition evidence

control_objective: Exceptions are approved at the right level time bound and compensated
Personnel understand their AI responsibilities
Users acknowledge the AI acceptable use policy
AI failures including near misses are reported and captured
Governance bodies receive complete and timely AI risk reporting
test_method: Review of reporting pack and minutes

control_objective: Complaints and feedback relating to AI outputs are captured and routed
Data classification is determined before deployment
Third party may not use bank data to train or improve models
Inference and storage occur only in permitted geographies

control_name: Retention defined for prompts and outputs
control_objective: Retention is set consistent with the records schedule
Sensitive data is prevented from reaching AI services

control_name: Data lineage and permitted use confirmed
control_objective: Training and reference data are permitted for the stated purpose
Each system is assessed against the bank model definition
Systems meeting the model definition receive independent validation
Generative systems are evaluated against a fixed versioned test set with thresholds
A current model card exists and reflects the deployed version
test_method: Compare model card version to deployed version

control_objective: Known limitations are communicated to the people using the system
Protected class exposure is tested before deployment and on cycle
Alternatives are evaluated and documented where disparity is found

control_name: Adverse action reasons accurate and specific
control_objective: Principal reasons reflect the actual basis of the decision
test_method: Sample reason codes against decision drivers

control_objective: No final adverse credit or account decision is fully automated
Systems processing untrusted input are tested before deployment
Retrieval respects the requesting user existing entitlements
Every permitted action is enumerated and scoped
test_method: Review action inventory against granted permissions

control_objective: Financial or irreversible actions require explicit human confirmation
Prompts outputs model version user and sources are logged
AI use occurs only through sanctioned tools
test_method: CASB and proxy review for unsanctioned services

control_objective: Credentials and keys are not entered into AI systems
AI specific due diligence is performed within third party risk
Vendor must give notice before material model or provider change
Fourth party model dependencies are known
test_method: Review disclosure and update dependency map

control_objective: AI features in existing software are identified and registered
test_method: Annual vendor AI questionnaire and admin console review

control_name: Default off for new AI features
control_objective: New vendor AI functionality requires affirmative enablement

control_name: Third party AI contingency and exit
control_objective: Failure and discontinuation scenarios are planned
Dependency on a single model provider is measured and reported
Each system has an operating monitoring plan with thresholds
Input and output drift are monitored against thresholds
Human override rate is tracked with a defined threshold
A defined share of outputs is reviewed by a qualified person
Deactivation is possible without a code release and has been tested
Model version changes follow change control and trigger reassessment
test_method: Compare version history to change records

control_objective: Customer facing generative interactions disclose AI and offer a human path
